title: Detestify configuration
description: Configuration for the six-command Detestify alpha. Repository configuration is untrusted until explicitly approved.

mode.description: Policy enforcement mode. Advisory is the public default.

base_revision.description: Optional Git base revision. Null requests automatic merge-base discovery.

trusted_operations.description: Explicit trust grants for operations that can execute repository code, mutate files, or use the network.

run_repository_commands.description: Whether Detestify may execute repository-defined commands.

evaluate_repository_config.description: Whether Detestify may load executable test-runner or build configuration.

install_dependencies.description: Whether Detestify may install dependencies. Alpha defaults to false.

network_access.description: Whether Detestify may make outbound network requests. Alpha defaults to false.

mutation.description: Whether optional mutation evidence may run.

create_hooks.description: Whether Detestify may write host hook configuration.

protected_tests.description: Tests that cleanup must retain unless a separately approved replacement record exists.

reason.description: Human-maintained reason this test is protected.

obligation_ids.description: Stable obligation identifiers protected by the test.

source.description: Repository policy, incident, contract, or approval record that established protection.

declared_obligations.description: Repository-declared obligations that can be referenced by obligation candidates.

statement.description: Observable behavior or invariant the repository owns.

source.description: Repository-relative policy, schema, contract, or issue reference.

gate_policy.description: Whether repository policy elevates the obligation above advisory behavior.

critical_paths.description: Repository paths with explicit obligation or materiality metadata.

pattern.description: Repository-relative glob interpreted by the implementation without shell expansion.

materiality_floor.description: Minimum materiality tier for matching changes.

runner.description: Explicit supported runner or automatic detection.

config_paths.description: Repository-relative configuration paths to inspect only after trust rules permit.

hook_limits.description: Portable limits applied before translating output into a host-specific shape.

model_visible_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes visible to the model from one hook result.

remediation_characters.description: Maximum Unicode characters in remediation text.

max_continuations.description: Maximum host continuations after an initial stop. Alpha requires one.

policy.description: Repository policy overrides that remain subject to provenance and safety invariants.

elevated_rule_ids.description: Derived rule identifiers explicitly elevated for balanced or strict gating.

allow_delete_candidates.description: Whether cleanup may emit DELETE_CANDIDATE when all evidence requirements hold. This never authorizes deletion.
